Greenhouse became robots-blocked/403 partway through, which removed my ability to verify Greenhouse-hosted roles. So discovery ran through the handful of reachable boards (arbeitnow, euremotejobs, startup.jobs, himalayas) and that capped the yield at 9 rather than 12 to 18.

Worth knowing about what I rejected, since it explains the thin count: the reachable Laravel/PHP and Node/React inventory is saturated with **Altamira** (skip-listed, 8+ distinct reqs) and **n8n** (skip-listed, 32 reqs). Genuine kills were Gr8Tech ("fluent in Ukrainian or Russian"), ECENT ("Deutsch C1" despite a perfect Next.js/Supabase stack match), Spotify (Java 17+ core), Lago (Czechia/Poland/Slovakia/Romania only), Solvd and Dev.Pro (LATAM / Ukraine only), Superplane (Go plus a mandatory GitHub pull request before applying), and Mindrift/Toloka (skip-listed). **Infuse** is a useful catch for the tracker: its Greenhouse URL now serves a 368-job board index, so that posting is dead exactly as the verification rule predicted.

Only Octocom cleared high verification. The three Ashby entries (Poolside, Improbable, Kiss My Apps) all returned bare "You need to enable JavaScript to run this app" bodies, so they are marked low by the stated rule even though Poolside and Improbable were both posted on 5 August. Kiss My Apps is the single best seniority-and-stack match found (2.5+ years, TypeScript/Node/React/Next.js/Postgres) but its posting body is entirely in Ukrainian, which I have flagged rather than silently passed along. Sama is the only lead whose stated band (EUR 35,000-44,000) sits inside the target.
